description: Angular component for rendering a latest chart widget, including legend handling, resize observation, and chart interactions.

classes.name: LatestChartComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying a latest chart with legend, resize handling, and interaction callbacks.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component state, styles, and legend configuration.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Creates the chart instance, sets up resize observer, and initializes resize handling.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and destroys chart instance.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Sets border radius style and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates chart and triggers resize if legend is horizontal.

methods.name: onLegendItemEnter
methods.description: Handles mouse enter on legend item, triggers key enter on chart.

methods.name: onLegendItemLeave
methods.description: Handles mouse leave on legend item, triggers key leave on chart.

methods.name: toggleLegendItem
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a legend item on the chart.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Adjusts chart shape size based on container dimensions.
